install.title: How to Install DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and Its Plugins
install.sub: Two commands in total: one to start DSH, one to add a plugin.
install.whatP: DeepSeek Harness is the agent framework DeepSeek open-sourced in August 2026. The community found the name a mouthful and just calls it dsh, same as the npm package {'@'}deepseek-ai/dsh. Its whole idea is that everything is a plugin: the UI, tools and skins all plug into a small core.
install.needP: You need Node.js on your machine — both npx and pnpm work for starting it. Type node -v in your terminal; a version number means you are ready. If nothing prints, grab the LTS build from the Node.js website.
install.startP1: The easy way is one npx command: no global install, and it boots straight into the web UI.
install.startP2: If you've already installed Claude Code or Codex, it's the same idea — one npx command and you're in.
install.startP3: If you would rather read the source or hack on it, cloning the official repo works just as well.
install.pluginP: With DSH running, installing a plugin is still one command. Swap owner/repo below for the plugin you want, paste it into your terminal, then enable the plugin on the DSH Web UI plugin page. All {n} plugin pages in this hub carry a one-click copy button — no typing needed.

faq.q1: How do I install DeepSeek Harness?
faq.a1: Make sure Node.js is installed, run npx {'@'}deepseek-ai/dsh web in your terminal, and the web UI opens in your browser. Cloning the official repo and running it locally works too.
faq.q2: How do I install a DSH plugin?
faq.a2: Run dsh plugin add github:owner/repo in your terminal with owner/repo pointing at the plugin repo, then enable it on the web UI plugin page. Every plugin page in this hub has a one-click copy button for the exact command.
faq.a3: Honestly, they are community projects and quality varies. Spend two minutes reading the code before installing, and keep in mind that plugins can touch your API key, so skip repos you do not trust.
faq.q4: How do I submit my own plugin?
faq.a4: Use the Submit page of this site with your repo link — we review every submission by hand.
faq.q5: Are dsh and DeepSeek Harness the same thing?
faq.a5: Yes. DeepSeek Harness is the full name, dsh is what the community calls it, and the npm package is {'@'}deepseek-ai/dsh.

install.typoP: A fair share of visitors get here by typing it wrong. deepseekharness without the space, deepseek hardness with an extra d, deepseek herness missing an a — all point to the same project. The correct spelling is DeepSeek Harness, two words, dsh for short. The commands above work no matter how you spelled it.

about.title: About DSH Meme Hub
about.p1: On Aug 13, 2026, DeepSeek open-sourced DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with the slogan "Everything is a Plugin". 96k stars later, the dsh-plugin topic holds thousands of repositories — and somewhere between the file managers and the TDD frameworks, the community built whale-girl desktop pets, QQ2006 skins, and a knockoff web-game ad network for your terminal.
about.p2: Other directories list everything, with trust scores and manifest checks. We do something different: we pick the good stuff — and the fun stuff. Every entry here was looked at by a human, has a working install command, and the meme section only contains things that made us actually laugh.
about.p3: Data (stars, last push, license, manifest presence) is refreshed from the GitHub API. This site is a static, fully prerendered, bilingual (EN/中文) guide — fast on any connection.
about.disclaimer: All screenshots are excerpted from the respective open-source projects' READMEs and belong to their original authors. Navigation and promotion only — no source or assets are redistributed. File an issue if any inclusion infringes your rights and it will be removed promptly.

footer.legal: DSH Meme Hub is an independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek. Screenshots belong to their respective authors.
